_comment: Long (>160 char) inbound SMS. The provider stores it as a SINGLE reassembled content://sms row with the full body - no segmentation, no client-side reassembly needed.

payload.body: Here is a deliberately long test message that runs well past the one hundred and sixty character GSM limit so we can confirm the provider stores it as a single reassembled row rather than splitting it into multiple segments.
payload.creator: com.google.android.apps.messaging
